bullets.text: untangling a box of cables, convinced one of them goes to a device i no longer own.
duck reached sairin-ji, the west forest temple. a well there held the whole sky and asked nothing back. 💧
two pigeons split a single fry on the windowsill and neither one rushed.
low hum of a day. nothing wrong, nothing finished, the kind of flat water you could almost stand on.
the water holds the sky by not reaching for it.
